text:
Darin: Heads-up: NewWave returned their security questionnaire and want a perf POC this Thurs. Requirements: mixed traffic (chat gen 70% / embeddings 30%), target sustained 150 rps, 95th < 250ms, 99th < 500ms. They also want a monthly cost estimate if they hit ~50M tokens/mo and confirmation we can use customer-managed KMS. Can we run this on Dedicated?

Melissa: Got it. I'll book infra. @Raman can you lead the load plan + runbook? Priya, please prep the security blurb for KMS / SOC2 / ISO27001.

Raman: I can. Quick thoughts: 150 rps sustained is borderline for a 2-GPU slice depending on model and quantization. Plan a stepped ramp: 40 -> 80 -> 120 -> 150 (15m each), with a 10m warmup of short prefixes to prime KV. Capture tokens/request, per-token latency, and CPU/GPU util. We'll include both fp16 and int8 runs.

Raman: Repro commands (example using wrk2 + simple JSON payload):
```bash
cat > payload.json <<EOF
{ "model": "open-lite-13b", "input": "Hello, prompt...", "max_tokens": 64 }
EOF
wrk -t8 -c100 -d15m -s ./scripts/wrk_post.lua -- "https://redwood.example/v1/generate" > wrk_40.log
# repeat with -R 80/120/150 for the sweep
```
(We also have scripts to mix embed calls every 3rd request.)

Priya: KMS note: yes, Dedicated + Private support CMK via our KMS integration; HSM-backed keys supported in Private deployments. Add statement about key rotation and audit logs (retention configurable). I'll attach a short Q&A for the customer with references to our SOC2 and ISO27001 summary.

Melissa: ops-bot, can you allocate a dedicated-small pool for 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC for a 90m window?

ops-bot: Allocation confirmed: dedicated-small (2x GPU slices) reserved for 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC 	6:00 UTC window id alloc-3f2d.

Raman: Pricing ballpark: rough calc assumptions: avg tokens per request = 120 (chat) / 16 (embed), mix 70/30. Hosted API price (public tier) ~ $0.00075/token -> ~ $37.5k/mo for 50M tokens. Dedicated amortized (2-GPU slice) incl infra & support ~ $22k-28k/mo at 60-70% utilization; with 3-GPU headroom ~$30k-36k. I'll include a small scenario table in the runbook.

Priya: Security Qs to surface: customer wants proof of SOC2 in last 12 months, key separation, and export controls. I'll state we have SOC2 Type II, CMK support, and specify where the evidence pack lives (link to secure share).

Melissa: Runbook items: 1) warmup 10m, 2) stepped ramp 60m total, 3) soak at target 20m, 4) capture wrk logs + perf metrics (prometheus snapshots + GPU telemetry), 5) abort criteria: 99th > 900ms or GPU mem > 90%. Raman drop artifacts into the runbook thread after the run.

Raman: Affirmative. After the sweep I'll upload wrk_40.log, wrk_80.log, wrk_120.log, wrk_150.log and a short summary with key numbers: RPS achieved, p50/p95/p99 latencies, tokens consumed, and cost per million tokens estimate. I'll also note differences fp16 vs int8.

Melissa: FYI customer demo slated Fri; we need green or clear blockers. Priya, leave the security Q&A as an appendix.

Priya: Will do. Also adding note: for Dedicated deployments we can enable private networking + customer-side VPC peering for extra compliance.

Darin: Thanks team. If anything looks rough during the run, call an immediate stop and loop in CS for messaging. :raised_hands:

Melissa: Perfect. Raman - ping if you want ops to extend the allocation.

Raman: Will do. Plan timeline: warmup 10m -> ramp 60m -> soak 20m -> post-checks 10m. Total ~100m. I'll post final artifacts and a 1-paragraph exec summary after the run.

Priya: I'll attach the security one-pager to the customer packet after Raman finishes.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: allocation alloc-3f2d will start at 2026-03-26 14:00 UTC.
